outline: 瞭解程式語言所常用之各種資結構，１.抽象資料類別及運算複雜度之概念，２.靜態結構及其儲存法，３.遞迴、堆疊、前序、中序、後序運算式，４.佇列，５.串列、鏈結串列，６.樹、二元樹、平衡樹、堆積，７.圖形，８.排序，９.搜尋、雜湊。
schedule:
1.  How to learn software program.
2. Structured language/structured program/object-oriented design.
3. Algorithm performance synthesis and testing.
4. Link list and Array.
5. Stack(Recursive): Software and Hardware.
6. Queue(Iterative)
7. Link list: Create/Insert/Delete operation.
8. Link list for Stack and Queue ( Circular list ).
9~10. tree: Thread; Inorder/Preorder/Postorder.
11. Parent: Inorder/Preorder/Postorder.
12.Heap: Priority Queue/ Max. Heap/ Min. Heap (add and delete )
13.Binary search Tree: add/ delete/ joining/ splitting
14. Selection Tree: Winner loser tree
15. Sorting: Insertion/Quick/merge/Heap/Radix
16~17. Link list and table sorts/ Hashing
assessment:
平時成績(含出席狀況):30%
報告和作業:70%
